title: Anastasia's Mate
setup: Your knight on e7 covers g6 and g8, and only the h7 pawn stands between the king and your queen.
hint: The knight already owns both g-squares. What is missing is the king on h7 — how do you insist?
explanation:
## The Idea

This is **Anastasia's mate**. {{Qxh7+}} forces {{Kxh7}}, and the knight on e7 takes g6 and g8 away. {{Rh3#}} completes the net: the king stands on an open file with nowhere to step. Learn the picture: knight on e7, king dragged to h7, rook to the h-file.
